notes: Makes Daily Operations navigation more visually and spatially distinct. Today opens at the start of the Today operational panel, Tomorrow opens at the start of the Tomorrow preparation panel, and Full Itinerary opens at the day after Tomorrow. Each jump now adds a clear START HERE landing marker, collapses the competing day panel, and positions the selected section below the sticky quick bar.
name: TEE v3.4.47 — Distinct Travel-Day Landing Positions
